changelog.content:
## Fixes

- Preserved partially read UoT frame headers and payloads while the opposite
  direction sends, preventing stream desynchronization and reconnect loops.
- Separated UoT socket and Core TUN read/write pumps so backpressure in one
  direction cannot prevent draining the other direction. The TUN fix also
  applies to the hidden Fake TCP carrier.
- Enabled TCP_NODELAY and combined UoT frame headers and payloads in vectored
  writes while preserving progress across short writes.
- Preferred authenticated direct routes to connected peers in both directions,
  avoiding unnecessary transit through a slower primary Hub while preserving
  ordered Hub failover and routes between Leaves with different assignments.

## Compatibility

- Fake TCP requires packet boundaries to survive between nodes. Transparent
  TCP proxies may split or combine packets even with a DIRECT outbound rule;
  exclude mesh carrier connections from proxy interception or use UoT.
- These fixes retain the existing mesh and signed-update wire protocols, so
  Master and Slave/Core pairs can be updated through the existing fleet flow.
